name: RSXYZ Public Company Limited
summary: Operating alongside its subsidiaries, RSXYZ Public Company Limited actively engages in the sourcing and distribution of chemical products across Thailand. The company also produces and markets a range of healthy food items. Furthermore, its business model includes the online trading of various products and services through e-commerce channels. Founded in 1999, the firm, which was previously known as Gift Infinite Public Company Limited, adopted its current name, RSXYZ Public Company Limited, in December 2024. Its main offices are located in Chatuchak, Bangkok, Thailand. This entity is a subsidiary of Union Petrochemical Public Company Limited.
